Polarus houses the legendary Polar Vaults. These vaults contained very valuable riches before the corporation went bankrupt. The corporation was known for their extremely high hiring rates. It also appears that many of these employees magically dissapeared after being fired.

> Moon map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Sacrificed/Deceased.

CONDITIONS: Cold, wet snowy terrain, supports plant life.

FAUNA: A balanced ecosystem, creatures support very agressive behaviour.

> Environment

Unfinished Section

This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section.

Polarus features an elevator, a ladder, moving platforms, and five fire exits. The exterior is massive, featuring a frozen lake with breakable ice platforms.

> Weather

Polarus can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

If Polarus is Eclipsed, the Ice Leviathan that is in the area with the two fire exits to the front left of the ship will not be present. Instead, a meteor will enter the atmosphere at 02:00pm and crash into this area at around 05:00pm. Any player nearby will die and any player within a large radius that extends all the way to the ship will quickly take 20 damage per hit. Approaching and inspecting this meteor will unlock Desolation.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Polarus you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Ice Leviathan (Visual)

Shortly after landing, an Ice Leviathan can be seen launching upward from the back of the ship to an area in front of the ship. When the player leaves the moon, an Ice Leviathan can again be seen launching upward from the back of the ship and it will proceed to attempt to devour the ship. This is purely visual.

Ice Leviathan (Hazard)

Polarus's exterior has an Ice Leviathan that moves through the area where the two fire exits in front and to the left of ship are located roughly every 20 seconds. Any player in its path will die.

Frozen Lake and Falling Icicles

On the frozen lake behind and below the ship are noticeable patches of ice. Ice Leviathans can break two patches of this ice when players approach or stand on them, while the other three patches of ice will break when a player stands on them for too long with too much weight. Some of the ice is also slippery, causing players to move faster in one direction but making it significantly more difficult to slow down or turn.

Additionally, icicles can fall onto players in the canyon paths in front of the ship. Any player that gets directly hit by an icicle will die.

Icy Walls

The pathway that leads to the two fire exits to the front right of the ship will begin randomly closing when a player walks through them. Any player will be crushed by these moving walls, though it can be survivable due to clipping issues. This makes these fire exits inaccessible without a jetpack or finding them in the interior for the rest of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Cunnigham's travel log 3" found on the exterior of Acidir.

Unlocks

Desolation: Visit Polarus while it is eclipsed. There will be a meteor in the sky that appears at around 02:00PM and crashes at around 05:00PM. Inspecting the meteor will unlock Desolation.
Cosmocos: Log "Cunningham's travel log 4" found on the exterior.
Etern: Etern videotape that spawns randomly spanws as scrap within the interior.
Gratar: Gratar videotape that spawns randomly as scrapt within the interior or log "Cunningham's visit" that spawns randomly as scrap within the interior.
Motra: Motra videotape that spawns randomly as scrap within the interior.
Oldred: Oldred videotape that spawns randomly as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Cunningham's Travel Log 4

The log can be found following the trail of reflectors in the canyons that are in front of the ship.

Text ⁠
Captains Log. Log 4. Location, Polarus.

First, my findings on Gratar.
We managed to trick that conniving AI into revealing the final letter to us.
It’s P.
It’s a capital P.
It’s smart - but we were smarter.
The ones of us that survived, anyway.
I think it realised we were deceiving it and it decimated 10 of us.
We’re down to a pathetic team of 8, half of whom are too disturbed to carry on their duties as usual.

Our ‘skeleton crew’ might be real skeletons, soon enough.
But I only need them to help pilot the ship for the last leg of our journey.

Because I’ve found it.
I know where Cosmocos is.

...I wonder if it felt the same loss that I felt...when I left?
Like my heart was wrenched from my chest.
To get to know something...some- someone... so magnificent...to know that you leave them blighted...wounded and sick...

I’ll be with you soon, old friend.
I’ll heal you.
I only need the opportunity.
And then we’ll be one again.

Cunningham. Signing off.

Undelivered Letters

Undelivered Letter 1

Image & Text ⁠
It's my second day working at this vault.

The work is quite boring if I'm bring honest.
But we are allowed to take breaks regularly!!

The people seem super nice as well, they make me feel at home.

I like it here.

But I do miss you and I hope to see you and the kids soon :)

From: employee-254 To [home address]

Undelivered Letter 2

Image & Text ⁠
It's my fifth day of work.

y apartment is surprisingly comfortable.
It's a long walk to the 'space bus' as I've started to call it.

There are also these strange noises below the ice, my co-worker speculated that it's the ice shifting.

I have asked if I could go home and see the kids at least once a week but they refused to let me go.
Probably because I am still in my proving period...

But I'll keep trying!
I can't wait to see you again!

From: employee-254 To [home address]

Undelivered Letter 3

Image & Text ⁠
It's been two weeks since my last letter.
I am getting a little more homesick every day.

I have noticed that a lot of newer employee get fired relatively quickly..
Most of them don't even last a month!

A co-worker of mine got fired as well.
I haven't from him since :(

We also had to divert a rescue ship from Infernis to Gratar due to some accident there.

But I've got good news!
They agreed to let me go home at the end of this month!!!

From: employee-254 To [home address]

Undelivered Letter 4

Image & Text ⁠
It's my last day before I can visit you.

Most of my co-workers got fired and it's getting a little quiet around here lately.

And there is definitely something below the ice, you can hear the growling in the deeper parts of the building.

But whatever it is they seem to keep it under control, maybe they are feeding it somehow.

Anyway, they will take me home at the end of the day.
I can't wait to see you!
I've missed you!

From: employee-254 To [home address]
